title: 250 Years of Celebration; 400 Years of Sweat Equity!

books.title: The History of the American Indians
The History of the American Indians

body:
IUIC in the ClassRoom · 2026-07-04

Opens [Deut 32](/bible/deuteronomy/32) · [Rev 12](/bible/revelation/12) · [Rev 17](/bible/revelation/17) · [2 Thess 2](/bible/2-thessalonians/2) · [Isa 14](/bible/isaiah/14) · [Jer 16](/bible/jeremiah/16) · [Wis 5](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/5) · [Ezek 1](/bible/ezekiel/1) · [Zech 5](/bible/zechariah/5) · [Jer 23](/bible/jeremiah/23) · [Judith 5](/bible/judith/5) · [2 Esdras 13](/bible/2-esdras/13)
## Introduction The class opened with Psalms 91 read in full, and prayer: strengthen us and free us, Father, from this captivity; open up our minds and our understanding; give us the water of thy word. Well, today is definitely a demonic day out here. It is a reminder that this day is celebratory for our enemies; to us it is detrimental and derogatory. It represents our complete abuse, our complete exploitation, and us being dominated. The class opened with Richard Pryor's old bicentennial routine: the caricature of a man in blackface with stars and stripes on his forehead, thrilled to be here after 200 years, thrilled that 360 of the 400 who came over on the boat died on the way, thrilled that his family was split apart. "Y'all probably done forgot about it. But I ain't gonna never forget it." Pryor was a conscientious comedian who put the real problems of our communities on the stage, and America would rather hide what has been done to us than let it reach the world stage. 250 years of celebration: America celebrating its independence from Great Britain, 1776. And 400 years of sweat equity: longer than 250 years, because we were slaving and toiling before this place even became America. We have been catching total abuse from the moment we were dragged off the ships. America is more prosperous after slavery, in terms of exploiting us, than when we were in slavery: in physical slavery we still had our minds and fought to be free, so an indoctrination program was built to make us willing slaves, to make us enslave ourselves and do evil to each other, while the merchants drain every dollar we work for. That is what they are celebrating: 250 years of shaping us into the sweat equity vehicles that allow all of them to prosper, while some of us jump up and down with them in red, white, and blue. This class goes into the psychology of how we got here, to compound with the classes that came before it today. ## Scriptures Opened **[Deuteronomy 32:26](/bible/deuteronomy/32#v26)** *[[15:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=900s)]* > [26](/bible/deuteronomy/32#v26) I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men: - I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men. That scripture is perfect for what was just said: it is not only written in prophecy, it is a way on how this is done. Your story does not get told in schools or on television; they do not want you to have anything to tell the world what you are experiencing. Even the term for our exhaustion gets turned around into "stop complaining," a total dismissal of your pain and anguish. - So they would rather hide us, abuse us, and then give us just enough dope to rejoice and say that we are okay. The celebrating of the so-called 4th of July, the 4th of You Lied, is basically a covering for a sick mind. How many more Sandra Blands, how many more Rasheem Carters, are we going to have with all this celebration? And it does not have to be all Esau: the mindset we have against each other came from them. We are basically men with black bodies and the oppressor's mind, and we do it to each other. **[Revelation 12:3](/bible/revelation/12#v3)** *[[23:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=1414s)]* > [3](/bible/revelation/12#v3) And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads. - And behold a great red dragon: this red dragon is talking about red people, a red nation. That is why the Most High said red. Why would he even call it red if it was not talking about you? **[Revelation 17:3-5, 18](/bible/revelation/17#v3)** *[[24:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=1475s)]* > [3](/bible/revelation/17#v3) So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns. > > [4](/bible/revelation/17#v4) And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication: > > [5](/bible/revelation/17#v5) And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH. > > [18](/bible/revelation/17#v18) And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth. - The woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth. The woman is the eighth head that came from the seven. The seven heads: Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia, and Great Britain. From that seventh head came America, and that is what they are celebrating: 250 years broken away from Great Britain. Why did the Lord have to explain this to John? Because this eighth head was a mystery to him: the other seven were back there under different names, but the eighth head did not yet exist in actuality. It existed in spirit, in prophecy, without a physical footprint on the earth. - I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast: a red beast. This chapter is going into America; no Christian is ever going to tell you anything about this. - Full of names of blasphemy: full of lies. America calls themselves Christians and calls themselves Jews and they are neither one. They lied on us: we are the real Jews that they dragged over here and subjugated into all kinds of evil. They came over here and murdered the brothers and sisters that were here in this country, and nearly wiped out Gad and Reuben. - Having seven heads and ten horns: horns mean power. America extracts its power from the ten; they are set up to fortify the endeavors of the main beast. That is NATO, basically. They add different names and cut it up, but you fit the prophecies of this Bible. - The woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls: she was decked out. Why? Because she stole the riches of the other nations. - Having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication: this place is loaded with abominations. She reigneth over the kings of the earth and made them all drunk with the wine of her fornication: that is what their foreign policy is all about. They make the nations drunk with weapons and with the lies of their religious programs, and indoctrinate and subjugate the nations to follow their dictates. - And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS. Mystery means: who is it? It had to be said that way, because nobody at that time knew about this eighth head. It was in the spiritual prophecy of coming; that is why John was able to write it. Christ showed it to him. **[2 Thessalonians 2:7](/bible/2-thessalonians/2#v7)** *[[33:14](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=1994s)]* > [7](/bible/2-thessalonians/2#v7) For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way. - For the mystery of iniquity: the mystery of sin. Who is the devil? Who is the evil one? Who is that man of sin? It is a mystery, meaning nobody is directly pointing at it. We are about to clear the mystery up. **[Isaiah 14:12-14](/bible/isaiah/14#v12)** *[[33:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=2029s)]* > [12](/bible/isaiah/14#v12) How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations! > > [13](/bible/isaiah/14#v13) For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north: > > [14](/bible/isaiah/14#v14) I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High. - How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! This chapter is future prophecy of the destruction of this very kingdom that we are in, written in the past tense. Lucifer means light bearer: they told everybody that they are the bright star of wisdom, the bright star of education, the bright star of justice. That is what the so-called Lady of Liberty is about; these people make all these symbols and statues up, and they know what they are doing when they set them up. Come to us if you want to talk about justice and judgment: a complete lie, a facade that hides the evil they have done to us. - Which didst weaken the nations: they weakened the nations with bombs, with their religion, with their so-called democracy and lies. That is how they got all the nations to serve them: the beast that reigneth over the earth weakened the nations until they had no strength to fight against it. - For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven: airplanes and space travel. I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: the Most High said we are supposed to dwell on this earth; this one says, I will go beyond your boundaries and put things out in the heavens, because I am God. That is how he thinks. - I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation: the congregation is the Lord's people. I will sit upon God's congregation in captivity: bewilder them, bewitch them, lie to them, give them false religion and evil holidays, and make them think the Bible is not talking about them. They are sitting on your thinking and your mentality. In the sides of the north: this hemisphere, where we are. **[Jeremiah 16:14-15](/bible/jeremiah/16#v14)** *[[37:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=2264s)]* > [14](/bible/jeremiah/16#v14) Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be said, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt; > > [15](/bible/jeremiah/16#v15) But, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers. - It shall no more be said, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt: that deliverance is still on the people's minds now. But the way they sat on our mentality, the world does not know the Bible is talking about us. That is how well they hid us; they manufactured a people and said these are the people the Bible speaks of. A total lie. You are the Jews; you are the Israelites. - But, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north: something so spectacular, so magnificent, and so marvelous has to happen that it makes us stop talking about ancient Egypt, the Red Sea, and the ten plagues. That is going to be when he delivers us from here, from the land of the north: the same place where we are being oppressed. **[Wisdom of Solomon 5:1-2](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/5#v1)** *[[40:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=2434s)]* > [1](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/5#v1) Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him, and made no account of his labours. > > [2](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/5#v2) When they see it, they shall be troubled with terrible fear, and shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation, so far beyond all that they looked for. - Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him. In the middle of the psychological tyranny and the physical tyranny that we face, the Most High says we are still going to stand in great boldness before the face of those that afflicted us. In their mind, there is no way we are supposed to be standing up: we afflicted them, and we mean to keep them hidden in the corners. - And made no account of his labours: they made no account of all the work we did beyond 250 years. What is a man celebrating in a top hat and stripes when in 1776 he was still in chains? - The teacher noted the Statue of Liberty: visitors do not see the feet of the statue, and there are chains at the base, a symbol of liberty breaking away from the grip of Britain. They understand breaking away for themselves, but we cannot want that for ourselves. People come to Ellis Island looking to that symbol while we are in slavery underneath this very system. - When they see it, they shall be troubled with terrible fear: when our enemies see us stand up in boldness, they shall be shaken, because they know who they have in captivity. The point is for you not to know who you are; they know who you are. As long as you do not know who you are, you will subject yourselves to inferior behavior and mediocrity, and shortchange yourselves, thinking no more of yourselves than what they taught you to think. - The terrible fear is you breaking out of that sickness and recognizing who you truly are, because they said that means the God of these people is soon to come. Our rise tells them we expect a deliverer; we expect Christ to come back. Once we start looking for that, you cannot buy us off. - And shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation: not only the people he is going to save, but how he is going to do it. The strangeness of his salvation was written in the Psalms we opened with: a thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee; only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked. - Drapetomania was brought up: the invented diagnosis that said a slave who seeks freedom from his master is mentally sick. He calls it sickness when you try to get away from him. That is the arrogance we are dealing with, and their mentality has not changed. **[Ezekiel 1:12](/bible/ezekiel/1#v12)** *[[51:31](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=3091s)]* > [12](/bible/ezekiel/1#v12) And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went. - And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went. The chariots. Wherever the spirit went, the chariots were there. They move at the speed of thought: as fast as you can think of a place, they can be there. They turned not when they went: they did not have to aim themselves; they just be, and they are. What could anybody do against the strangeness of that kind of salvation? No jet fuel, no propulsion, no sound, the wind undisturbed. - Discussion of what the astronauts saw: the maneuvers and technology of the chariots made the whole space program look like a bicycle. Do you think those beings need all of that to get two men up there? **[Zechariah 5:1-4](/bible/zechariah/5#v1)** *[[54:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=3248s)]* > [1](/bible/zechariah/5#v1) Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll. > > [2](/bible/zechariah/5#v2) And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits. > > [3](/bible/zechariah/5#v3) Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it. > > [4](/bible/zechariah/5#v4) I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof. - Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll: the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits. That is a sizeable ship. And how could Zechariah make out the words written on it from where he stood, like reading a billboard, unless the thing was enormous? - This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: the Lord is saying, I am going to send a chariot to terrorize my enemies. On one side: every one that stealeth shall be cut off. On the other side: every one that sweareth shall be cut off. - America is a major thief, and an amazing liar: swearing that they are the Israelites, swearing In God We Trust while the very ground the courts sit on is stolen property. - I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: those that lied on the Bible, that told the nations the Bible was about them while the children of Israel suffered under their brutality. And it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof: fire and brimstone destruction. They know what those chariots represent. **[Jeremiah 23:7-8](/bible/jeremiah/23#v7)** *[[1:01:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=3703s)]* > [7](/bible/jeremiah/23#v7) Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that they shall no more say, The Lord liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt; > > [8](/bible/jeremiah/23#v8) But, The Lord liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land. - The same prophecy again, and this one uses the word country: which brought up, and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country. The Most High is coming back to take us home from the north country. **[Isaiah 14:15-17](/bible/isaiah/14#v15)** *[[1:03:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=3800s)]* > [15](/bible/isaiah/14#v15) Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit. > > [16](/bible/isaiah/14#v16) They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms; > > [17](/bible/isaiah/14#v17) That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners? - Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit: you are not going to stop your downfall. - They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man? The man of sin: Lucifer is a man. To narrowly look means you are squinting, taking a good look, really examining that thing. You remove the rose-colored glasses, the facade, the glitz and glamour, the imagery everybody goes crazy over, and you see exactly who he is. What is going to cause them to see? The Bible. The Bible is going to reveal who these people really are. - Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms: by dropping bombs on the kingdoms. Coming to another man's land and taking him out of his land while everybody stands by: that is the kind of terror we are talking about. - That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof: destroyed the air, the water, and the people's minds. Folly is set in great dignity: when the wicked bear rule, the people mourn. **[2 Thessalonians 2:3-8](/bible/2-thessalonians/2#v3)** *[[1:10:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=4228s)]* > [3](/bible/2-thessalonians/2#v3) Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition; > > [4](/bible/2-thessalonians/2#v4) Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God. > > [5](/bible/2-thessalonians/2#v5) Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things? > > [6](/bible/2-thessalonians/2#v6) And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time. > > [7](/bible/2-thessalonians/2#v7) For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way. > > [8](/bible/2-thessalonians/2#v8) And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming: - Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first: Paul telling the Israelites that day would not come except Israel go into complete captivity, like where we are now. All of this is prophesied, and our deliverance is also prophesied. - And that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition: there is the mystery again. They shall take a good look at him, narrowly look upon him, and recognize that this man is the devil the Bible speaks of. Perdition means destruction: he was made to be destroyed by God, the vessel of God's wrath. Keep that word in mind, because when we go back to Revelation you will see it again. - Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God: he opposed God, the Bible, and all righteousness. Thou enemy of all righteousness, thou child of the devil: Acts 13, Elymas the sorcerer. - So that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God: he built the churches and monuments and made everybody think that he is God. - For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: Paul takes it back to when they were literally under Rome. The wicked was already ruling; Paul was letting you know who the devil was. - Only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way: only the Lord who now allows him to rule will let him rule, and when their time is up, they are done. The sand is running out of the hourglass, and everyone who is tied up with them goes down with them. **[Revelation 17:5-11](/bible/revelation/17#v5)** *[[1:16:32](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=4592s)]* > [5](/bible/revelation/17#v5) And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH. > > [6](/bible/revelation/17#v6) And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration. > > [7](/bible/revelation/17#v7) And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns. > > [8](/bible/revelation/17#v8) The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is. > > [9](/bible/revelation/17#v9) And here is the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth. > > [10](/bible/revelation/17#v10) And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space. > > [11](/bible/revelation/17#v11) And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition. - Mystery, Babylon the great: Babylon, land of great lies, land of confusion. The mother of harlots: America makes all the nations get in bed with her and follow her ways. If you do not accept her foreign policies and political agendas, they cut your money off, cut your food off, put embargoes and sanctions on you until you cannot even sell your own goods. What other country can do that? Nobody. Only this beast. - And abominations of the earth: the worst abominations of all time are right here, and the sickness is so pervasive that the people subject to the abominations think they are in heaven. We are drowning in abominations while thinking this is Utopia. - And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints: America drank our blood in captivity, robberies, murder, and slavery. And with the blood of the martyrs: a lot of our people trying to do right have been knocked off. - And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns: I will tell you about the eighth head, America, and about the seven that carried her. - The beast that thou sawest was, and is not: it was in John's vision, but it was not in existence in his time. And shall ascend out of the bottomless pit: out of Europe, out of Britain and the rest. And go into perdition: there is that word again from Thessalonians. - The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth: seven mountains means seven governments. And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is: Rome, the one that had John on the isle of Patmos, was in power; Greece, Spain, France, Germany, and Russia were not. And the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space: Great Britain was still coming along. - And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven: America is of Great Britain and the rest of the seven heads. And goeth into perdition: this kingdom is going to be destroyed. That is the history of it, and there is no getting out of it. **[Revelation 12:10](/bible/revelation/12#v10)** *[[1:34:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=5655s)]* > [10](/bible/revelation/12#v10) And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night. - For the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night. Esau is the accuser, accusing our people before our God: look, the Israelites are in sin; we have them in adultery, in dope, drunk, celebrating the false holidays; these are your people, and they know better. That is them accusing us, like somebody telling your parents your children are worthless, while setting the children up to fail. - Clips from the film 1492: Conquest of Paradise were played: Columbus arguing that he could cross the ocean, and when asked how he could be so certain of the distance, citing his sources: the calculations of mariners, and Esdras. The Bible. Columbus had logbooks and records; he was looking for the twelve tribes of Israel. He knew there was land out there because he read the book. Movies are not made for our entertainment: they put things out there because they know our people are asleep, and they measure whether we are waking up. If too many wake up, they adjust the dope: the religion dope, the education dope, the television dope, the music. Once you think outside the box, they call you a radical, an extremist, a hate group: all of it designed to put you back in your place. - A lecture clip was played on the Huxtable effect: when positive images of our people were broadcast, test scores rose, 75 percent of black males graduated high school in 1990, and enrollment at Morehouse College went up 37 percent. Then came the opposite effect: scores went down, and by 2010 graduation had fallen to 47 percent. The music our people ask for is chosen by executives worth billions who market racist images of black people. It is the corporate sale of racism. Nothing is put out here for your entertainment: everything allowed to reach your ears and your screen is carefully sculpted to produce a thought, which becomes your actions, which become your destiny. They allowed the positive images as a test, saw that we respond to imagery, and then changed the music and the images to put us back to sleep: sweat equity. - The Greeks, Columbus's ancestors, learned to search out everyone's history: their strengths and their weaknesses.
Reading from a book of Flavius Josephus, on Demetrius Phalereus and the king's library *[[1:51:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4fML805MO8A&t=6706s)]* > He procured the law to be interpreted, and set free those that were come from Jerusalem into Egypt, and were in slavery there, who were 120,000. > > The occasion was this. Demetrius Phalereus, who was library keeper to the king, was now endeavoring, if it were possible, to gather together all the books that were in the habitable earth, and buying whatsoever was anywhere valuable, or agreeable to the king's inclination, who was very earnestly set upon collecting of books, to which inclination of his Demetrius was zealously subservient. And when once Ptolemy asked him how many 10,000s of books he had collected, he replied that he had already about 20 times 10,000, but that in a little time he should have 50 times 10,000. But he said he had been informed that there were many books of laws among the Jews worthy of inquiring after, - If the Greeks are talking like that, you got to understand Esau takes care of Esau. They'll get the books. When they died, they passed the books down. The Romans came from the Greeks. Spain came from the Romans. So that history goes all the way down. So Columbus got that understanding. - I'm talking real facts here when I talk about how they deal with books. Me and Deacon Asaph, New York.
